title: A Revisit of Fake News Dataset with Augmented Fact-checking by ChatGPT

bias_targets.methodology: The authors measure political bias in fact-checking by dividing news creators into three affiliations (Democrat, Republican, and Social Media). They evaluate 'content bias' by calculating the frequency of strongly and weakly subjective words using linguistic lexicons within the fact-checking texts. They also evaluate 'credibility assessment criteria bias' by comparing the strictness of human journalists' truthfulness labels against ChatGPT's scoring to identify discrepancies and leniency/harshness directed at specific political parties.
